Trying to find something good on Prime Video right now? Well they just added 100 movies!

Every month, I dig through everything hitting streaming and pull out the movies actually worth your time. Here you’ve got high-end crime, crowd-pleasing blockbusters, a few forgotten classics, and some movies that flat-out surprised me. It’s one of those lineups where there’s something for everyone… but only if you know where to look.

Prime is adding hits like The Running Man, The Conjuring Last Rights, Crime 101 and a lot more in April, making it a great month to be a Prime member.
